rows.quote: damage_per_armor.base: [0.25]→[0.55845]
rows.reason_zh: 该字段只说明每点护甲的伤害加成提高，材料未给出判定可破坏性所需的 IsBreakable 值。

rows.quote: Discharges high-powered shrapnel at random nearby enemy units, dealing minor magical damage and ministun.
rows.reason_zh: 一次施放的弹片仍可击中附近多个敌人，本次调整只降低了魔耗。

rows.quote: dealing minor magical damage and ministun.
rows.reason_zh: 弹片命中仍会造成小眩晕。

rows.quote: Battery Assault : Increased radius and affects all enemies in its range.
rows.reason_zh: 原行所记的强化仍使弹幕冲击命中范围内所有敌人。

rows.quote: Jetpack : Moves faster.
rows.reason_zh: 超速运转仍提高发条技师使用喷气背包时的移动速度。

rows.quote: Clockwerk's movement and attack speed become slowed to a crawl after the duration runs out.
rows.reason_zh: 效果结束时减速的是发条技师自己，对敌减速只出现在照明火箭的强化说明中。

rows.quote: Hookshot : Stun radius and duration increased.
rows.reason_zh: 眩晕由发射钩爪施加，超速运转本身只扩大其范围并延长持续时间。

rows.quote: Enemies outside the trap that touch a cog are knocked back, losing health and mana. Once a cog has delivered a shock, it will power down.
rows.reason_zh: 一次施放产生多个齿轮，每个齿轮都可电击接触它的敌人，因此一次施放可伤害多个目标。

rows.quote: Enemies outside the trap that touch a cog are knocked back
rows.reason_zh: 从圈外碰到齿轮的敌人仍会被击退。

rows.quote: Cogs can shock invisible units.
rows.reason_zh: 齿轮能电击已经隐身的单位，说明中没有赋予任何单位隐身的效果。

rows.quote: Damage is increased by %mana_burn_as_damage_pct%%% of the mana burned.
rows.reason_zh: 齿轮仍会削减敌方法力，并按烧掉的法力增加伤害。

rows.quote: Forms a ring of energized cogs around Clockwerk, trapping any units that are near.
rows.reason_zh: 齿轮仍在地面围成可阻挡单位通行的环，发条技师自身可穿过。

rows.quote: stealing damage from the target and giving it to Razor.
rows.reason_zh: 连接仍会夺取目标的攻击力并转给雷泽。

rows.quote: Creates a charged link between Razor and an enemy Hero
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能仍以一个敌方英雄为连接目标。

rows.quote: a forked lightning that strikes the target and other nearby enemies
rows.reason_zh: 一次触发的闪电仍可同时伤害目标及附近其他敌人。

rows.quote: Lightning strikes all enemies within Eye of the Storm's radius.
rows.reason_zh: 持有魔晶且风暴之眼生效时，闪电仍会击中其范围内所有敌人。
伤害字段只给出闪电伤害，材料未给出 IsBreakable 值。

rows.quote: There's a chance when attacked, and always when targeted with a spell, to release a forked lightning
rows.reason_zh: 遭受攻击时仍有概率释放反击闪电，被技能选为目标时必定触发。

rows.quote: dealing damage and slowing movement speed.
rows.reason_zh: 闪电仍会降低被击中敌人的移动速度。

rows.quote: when targeted with a spell, to release a forked lightning
rows.reason_zh: 被技能选为目标时释放的是风暴涌动自身的闪电，原技能没有被反弹给施法者。

rows.quote: Counts as a critical strike, and so does not stack with other critical strikes.
rows.reason_zh: 装备被动仍明确计为暴击，触发概率和额外伤害比例虽下调但都大于零。

rows.quote: spell_lifesteal.base: [15]→null
rows.reason_zh: 7.42 删除了装备原有的技能吸血数值，现行说明也没有其他吸血效果。

rows.quote: deal an additional %crit_multiplier%%% of the attack's damage as bonus magical damage.
rows.reason_zh: 触发时直接附加魔法伤害，没有降低目标魔抗或提高目标所受魔法伤害的效果。

rows.quote: Every time Riki strikes his enemy from behind, he deals additional bonus damage equal to a multiple of his Agility and his attack has increased Item Potency.
rows.reason_zh: 背刺仍作用于这次攻击的目标，新增物品效能没有使攻击波及其他单位。

rows.quote: he deals additional bonus damage equal to a multiple of his Agility and his attack has increased Item Potency.
rows.reason_zh: 背后攻击仍附带按敏捷计算的额外伤害，7.42 又提高了该次攻击的物品效能。

rows.quote: bonus_potency.base: null→[10]
rows.reason_zh: 新增字段说明物品效能提高，材料未给出 IsBreakable 值以核实原先的否定判断。

rows.quote: Enemies caught in the smoke screen have their armor reduced by %armor_reduction%
rows.reason_zh: 魔晶说明仍明确降低烟幕内敌人的护甲。
各级烟幕仍使敌方攻击有概率落空，前三等级的落空率提高。

rows.quote: Throws down a smoke bomb, silencing enemies and causing them to miss attacks.
rows.reason_zh: 烟幕仍在投放处持续影响区域内的敌人，调整后的半径为 400，持续时间为 4.5 至 6 秒。

rows.quote: silencing enemies and causing them to miss attacks.
rows.reason_zh: 烟幕仍对敌人施加沉默。

rows.quote: illusion_effectiveness.base: null→[25]
rows.reason_zh: 新增字段描述幻象效能，使用说明和字段均未说明每次使用是否消耗一点充能。

rows.quote: Creates %images_count% imperfect image of your hero that lasts %illusion_duration% seconds.
rows.reason_zh: 使用哈哈镜仍会制造持续一段时间的自身幻象。

rows.quote: Has a %invuln_duration% second cast time during which you are invulnerable.
rows.reason_zh: 施法者在哈哈镜的施法动作期间仍处于无敌状态。

rows.quote: If he strikes an enemy, the dagger deals impact damage, briefly slows the unit hit, and causes them to bleed.
rows.reason_zh: 冲击和流血均作用于尖刀命中的单个敌人，本次仅调整冲击伤害数值。

rows.quote: briefly slows the unit hit
rows.reason_zh: 尖刀仍会短暂降低命中目标的移动速度。

rows.quote: Illusions hit by the beam fade away, losing a percentage of their maximum health each second.
rows.reason_zh: 说明写明受照幻象逐秒损失生命，本次只调整攻击落空率，没有加入对区域内敌人造成伤害的效果。

rows.quote: miss_chance.base: [30]→[45]
rows.reason_zh: 受照敌人的攻击落空概率从 30% 提高到 45%，致盲仍然生效。

rows.quote: Ringmaster shines %spotlight_count% spotlights that sweep over an area. Enemies in the light have a chance to miss their attacks and are revealed if invisible.
rows.reason_zh: 聚光灯仍扫过指定区域并持续影响处于光照中的敌人，本次仅提高落空概率。

rows.quote: are revealed if invisible.
rows.reason_zh: 隐身敌人受光照时仍会显形。

rows.quote: Enemies in the light have a chance to miss their attacks and are revealed if invisible.
rows.reason_zh: 说明将显形施加于受照的隐身目标，没有赋予持续真视。

rows.quote: Attacking, using channeled abilities, or crashing into units and other obstacles also dismounts the rider.
rows.reason_zh: 使用持续施法技能是下车条件，骑行本身没有持续引导要求。

rows.quote: mount_duration.base: [10]→[15]
rows.reason_zh: 字段只说明骑行时间延长，材料未说明每次使用是否消耗一点充能。

rows.quote: Crashing into trees destroys them and slows the unicycle.
rows.reason_zh: 撞树后减速的是独轮车自身，没有对敌方单位施加减速。

rows.quote: Crashing into trees destroys them
rows.reason_zh: 独轮车撞到树木时仍会摧毁树木。

rows.quote: enemies in range of the wheel take damage over time
rows.reason_zh: 奇观轮仍可持续伤害范围内多个敌人，各级伤害调整后均大于零。

rows.quote: knocking aside enemies along the way.
rows.reason_zh: 奇观轮滚向目标位置时仍会将沿途敌人推开。

rows.quote: After it reaches its target, enemies in range of the wheel take damage over time and are slowed by %aura_slow%%%.
rows.reason_zh: 奇观轮抵达目标地点后仍在该处形成持续伤害并减速敌人的区域。

rows.quote: Enemy heroes who face the wheel for more than %face_duration% seconds are mesmerized and drawn towards it.
rows.reason_zh: 敌方英雄面朝奇观轮达到指定时长后，仍会被迫向它移动。

rows.quote: enemies in range of the wheel take damage over time and are slowed by %aura_slow%%%.
rows.reason_zh: 奇观轮抵达目标位置后仍会降低范围内敌人的移动速度。

rows.quote: are mesmerized and drawn towards it.
rows.reason_zh: 面朝奇观轮触发的控制是强制走向轮子，说明没有赋予眩晕效果。

rows.quote: Use: Whoopsie Propels your hero forward %leap_distance% units.
rows.reason_zh: 说明给出使用时的位移效果，但没有充能字段或每次使用消耗一点的说明。

rows.quote: Leaves a %fart_cloud_radius% radius stink cloud behind for %fart_cloud_duration% seconds that slows enemies by %fart_cloud_slow%%%.
rows.reason_zh: 前跃后仍在身后留下持续减速敌人的臭云，作用半径从 250 增至 300。

rows.quote: Propels your hero forward %leap_distance% units.
rows.reason_zh: 使用整蛊垫仍会将自身向前推进一段距离。

rows.quote: fart_cloud_slow.base: [-30]→[-35]
rows.reason_zh: 臭云对敌人的移动减速幅度从 30% 提高到 35%。

rows.quote: Propels your hero forward %leap_distance% units.
rows.reason_zh: 说明只确认向前位移，未交代途中是否能越过悬崖或穿过树木。

rows.quote: Active: Cripple Roots the target for %duration% seconds.
rows.reason_zh: 主动效果仍会缠绕目标，本次仅提高装备的智力加成。
材料给出了法术放大和施法距离的变化，但未给出判定可破坏性所需的 IsBreakable 值。
各级法术放大均有下调，但仍提供正值加成。

rows.quote: Rubick can use this spell as his own for several minutes or until he dies.
rows.reason_zh: 技能让拉比克学会并自行施放目标的技能，没有将来袭技能反弹给施法者的效果。

rows.quote: Upgrades stolen spells to their Shard version.
rows.reason_zh: 魔晶只升级已窃取技能的版本，窃取能力由基础技能提供。

rows.quote: learning the secrets of the last spell the hero cast. Rubick can use this spell as his own
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能仍允许拉比克获得并使用敌方英雄最近施放的技能。

rows.quote: Rubick studies the trace magical essence of one enemy hero
rows.reason_zh: 施法时仍选择一个敌方英雄作为窃取目标。

rows.quote: damaging and stunning enemy units above him as he resurfaces.
rows.reason_zh: 基础穿刺仍能在钻出地面时伤害上方多个敌方单位。

rows.quote: Sand King burrows into the ground and tunnels forward
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能仍使沙王钻入地下并向前位移。

rows.quote: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
rows.reason_zh: 该注释描述掘地穿刺与技能格挡的交互，技能效果中也没有为沙王或队友格挡来袭技能的能力。

rows.quote: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
rows.reason_zh: 该注释描述掘地穿刺与技能反弹的交互，技能效果中也没有将来袭技能反弹给施法者的能力。

rows.quote: damaging and stunning enemy units above him as he resurfaces.
rows.reason_zh: 沙王钻出地面时仍会眩晕命中的敌方单位。

rows.quote: Sand King burrows into the ground and tunnels forward
rows.reason_zh: 地下前移的说明没有交代技能能否穿过树木或越过不可通行地形。

new_mechanisms.quote: create Stinger attack areas along the path, that apply %spine_damage_pct%%% of Stinger damage to enemies hit.
new_mechanisms.reason_zh: 新增 A 杖升级使路径上的尖刺在 0.8 秒后造成 75% 的 Stinger 范围伤害，现有行仅记录基础穿刺的范围伤害。

rows.quote: ability_has_scepter: true→false
rows.reason_zh: 虽然仍保留旧版 A 杖说明，但升级标记已关闭，额外攻击区域的数量和伤害字段也已删除。

rows.quote: All enemies caught within range will take damage and become slowed.
rows.reason_zh: 基础地震仍对范围内所有敌人造成伤害。

rows.quote: All enemies caught within range will take damage and become slowed.
rows.reason_zh: 基础脉冲仍会使范围内敌人减速。
